name: helium
title: Helium
description: Navigate open tabs, bookmarks, and the web in Helium browser
author: islamtayeb

preferences.name: searchEngine
preferences.title: Search Engine
preferences.description: Choose your preferred search engine for suggestions and searches

preferences.name: heliumPath
preferences.title: Helium Location
preferences.description: Only needed for portable or non-default installs. Windows: the path to Helium's chrome.exe (for example C:\Users\you\AppData\Local\imput\Helium\Application\chrome.exe). macOS: the path to Helium.app. Leave empty to detect it automatically.

preferences.name: userDataPath
preferences.title: User Data Directory (Windows)
preferences.description: Optional existing User Data folder containing Local State and profile folders for a custom or portable installation.

commands.name: search-tabs
commands.title: Search Tabs
commands.description: Search and navigate through open tabs in Helium browser

commands.name: search-web
commands.title: Search Web
commands.description: Search the web with Helium browser

commands.name: search-history
commands.title: Search History
commands.description: Search browsing history from Helium browser

commands.name: search-bookmarks
commands.title: Search Bookmarks
commands.description: Search and open bookmarks from Helium browser

commands.name: open-new-tab
commands.title: Open New Tab
commands.description: Open a new tab in Helium browser

commands.name: open-new-window
commands.title: Open New Window
commands.description: Open a new window in Helium browser

commands.name: open-new-incognito-window
commands.title: Open New Incognito Window
commands.description: Open a new incognito window in Helium browser

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
